system.description:
A social creature, pack animals focus on group dynamics and control in a fight, using herd tactics to drive the course of combat. Your chosen Pack Form should be a medium-sized pack animal that lives in herds such as a zebra, saiga antelope, llama, wolves, or wild boar.

Hulinari are both an Ancestry and a Profession: if you choose to play one, you must take the other. Every Hulinari Ancestry is a unique animal; choose your species. This also sets your Hulinari Warrior form.

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.e9d3cb52b2fe1160]{Graceful Animal}, @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.c94cb3fa33157db1]{With All Haste}

Hulinari Heritage. Rulebook p.92.
